title: Revalidate mailbox Bind-retry eligibility atomically when parking
outcome: A narrow mailbox Remote Bind reconciliation cannot schedule retry authority after its delegation, recovered-admission, observation, durability or cleanup exclusions change between failure-time selection and the park. Exact original identity and later authority fences remain intact.
acceptance: The mailbox-specific exclusions are revalidated under the same StateInner lock that decides and persists retry eligibility, without weakening the existing owner, head, authority, runtime, grant and payload guards.

Deterministic interleaving tests introduce relevant holds after failure-time selection and before park, assert a conservative retained outcome without a mailbox-specific retry grant, and preserve exact request/key, content and no duplicate provider handoff.
Focused verification passes on the exact input and independent review has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
